description: This file contains platform-specific implementations for radio and interrupt handling in a Zephyr-based embedded system, specifically for STM32WBA hardware. It includes functions for clock initialization, delay, RNG retrieval, interrupt setup and handling, and radio event control.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_ClockInit
methods.description: Initializes the clock for the radio subsystem, enabling backup access and selecting LSE as sleep clock.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_DelayUs
methods.description: Busy-waits for the specified number of microseconds.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_WaitHclkRdy
methods.description: Waits until the radio bus clock is ready.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_AclkCtrl
methods.description: Enables or disables the radio baseband clock and polls for HSE32 readiness.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_GetRNG
methods.description: Retrieves random data from hardware RNG.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_SetupRadioIT
methods.description: Sets up the radio interrupt callback.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_SetupSwLowIT
methods.description: Sets up the software low priority interrupt callback.

methods.name: radio_high_prio_isr
methods.description: ISR for high priority radio interrupt, calls callback and manages wake-up event.

methods.name: radio_low_prio_isr
methods.description: ISR for low priority radio interrupt, manages nested interrupt state and callback.

methods.name: link_layer_register_isr
methods.description: Registers and enables the radio and software low priority interrupts.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_TriggerSwLowIT
methods.description: Triggers the software low priority interrupt with specified priority.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_EnableIRQ
methods.description: Enables global IRQs with reference counting.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_DisableIRQ
methods.description: Disables global IRQs with reference counting.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_Assert
methods.description: Asserts a condition.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_EnableSpecificIRQ
methods.description: Enables specific IRQs based on type, managing counters and priorities.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_DisableSpecificIRQ
methods.description: Disables specific IRQs based on type, managing counters and priorities.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_EnableRadioIT
methods.description: Enables radio interrupt.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_DisableRadioIT
methods.description: Disables radio interrupt.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_StartRadioEvt
methods.description: Starts radio event, enabling clock and notifying radio state.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_StopRadioEvt
methods.description: Stops radio event, disabling clock and notifying radio state.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_RequestTemperature
methods.description: Placeholder for temperature request.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_SCHLDR_TIMING_UPDATE_NOT
methods.description: Placeholder for scheduler timing update notification.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_EnableOSContextSwitch
methods.description: Placeholder for enabling OS context switch.

methods.name: LINKLAYER_PLAT_DisableOSContextSwitch
methods.description: Placeholder for disabling OS context switch.
